title: FAA orders nationwide ground stop for all US flight departures
summary: The grounding was the first nationwide flight stoppage since January 2023, when an FAA computer system malfunctioned. Before that, the last nationwide grounding followed the terrorist attacks of Sept. 11, 2001.

title: US Democrats direct Musk to preserve records on Ukraine's Starlink restriction, WSJ reports
summary: "The October and November restrictions now raise the disturbing possibility that these vulnerabilities persist even within systems on which the U.S. government relies," Senators Jeanne Shaheen and Chris Coons wrote.

title: Historic first summit for Trump, Xi, Putin will not focus on Ukraine, White House says
summary: A U.S. official said that a trilateral meeting has been planned, but will focus on nuclear non-proliferation and the war in Iran.

title: US Air Force responds to suspected drone activity at military base in UK
summary: The U.S. Air Force has maintained a presence at the base since 1948, as part of the longstanding military partnership between the United States and the United Kingdom.

title: Ukraine hits key Russian oil hub, military airbase in latest long-range strikes
summary: The General Staff reported a fire at the Samara linear production control station near the village of Prosvet in Samara Oblast, some 950 kilometers east of Ukraine-controlled territory, with several oil storage tanks on fire.

title: Zelensky says Starshield restrictions give Russia more room to attack, accuses SpaceX of treating occupied territories as 'not ours'
summary: "If you impose restrictions there, you are already partially recognizing the temporarily occupied territories as not ours," Zelensky told journalists, referring to the existing ban on Ukraine using Starshield to target sites inside Russia, which has now been partially extended to Ukrainian territories occupied by Moscow.

title: US floats NATO membership for Ukraine in exchange for Donbas withdrawal, Zelensky says
summary: "The Americans raised the question: 'What if Ukraine joins NATO? Would Ukraine withdraw from Donbas?' This was the first time this issue had been raised," President Volodymyr Zelensky told journalists.

title: At least 7 killed, 80 injured in Russian attacks across Ukraine; Zaporizhzhia among worst hit
summary: In Zaporizhzhia Oblast, Russian attacks killed three people, including a child, and injured 62 others, including eight children, Governor Ivan Fedorov said.

title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,620,630 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
summary: Russian forces suffered 1,710 casualties over the past day.
